runtime.note: Framework-dependent single-file today (Service + CLI); the rag-indexer is Native AOT. Packaged builds publish --self-contained so a node needs no .NET runtime.

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: every tool the assistant can call reaches the engine through kgsm-lib

services.name: ollama
services.why: the agent loop's model backend — the assistant has no other inference path
services.without: the leaf starts and every turn fails
services.warning: Must stay bound to 127.0.0.1. Binding it to a routable address exposes an unauthenticated inference endpoint to the internet.

services.name: nginx
services.why: public TLS ingress for the standalone assistant SPA
services.without: the assistant serves on its own port only

units.note: The rag-indexer is optional and installed with --with-indexer. It indexes the knowledge corpus under the engine's docs directory; without it, retrieval serves whatever index already exists.

network.why: the search tool's fallback when local retrieval finds nothing
network.without: the assistant answers from the local corpus only
